decisions.reason: The supplement range draws directly on the firm's established consumer health formulation knowledge and pharmacy channels, so the firm can read market feedback and keep refining the line instead of abandoning it.

As an extension of the established Trivital line, the joint health supplement fits existing regulatory, formulation and marketing know-how, though missing website evidence since 2019 adds some uncertainty.

The OTC triptan is distant from the consumer supplement offer, but the firm's in-house pharmaceutical development, generics and regulatory capabilities give it enough related knowledge to assimilate learning from the Rx-to-OTC switch, so it is worth keeping despite a higher risk than the core lines.
